title: LiteDuck plugin manifest (plugin.json)
description: JSON Schema for a LiteDuck `plugin.json` manifest. Derived from the authoritative loader `PluginManifest` / `ALLOWED_KINDS` / `DENIED_KINDS` in liteduck `src-tauri/src/plugins.rs`. If this schema and plugins.rs ever disagree, plugins.rs wins.

id.description: Stable plugin id. Becomes the install directory name `~/.liteduck/plugins/<id>/`. Must not contain path separators or `..` (loader rejects traversal).

name.description: Human-readable display name shown in the Plugins panel.

description.description: Short description surfaced in the catalog and install UI.

kind.description: Contribution kind. Allow-list enforced by plugins.rs ALLOWED_KINDS. The kinds `chat`, `agent`, `llm` are on the scope-ceiling deny-list (DENIED_KINDS) and are refused at load time — LiteDuck core has no AI/LLM.

network.description: Whether the plugin needs network access. Declared here, surfaced in the install confirmation UI. Not OS-enforced in v1 (user-trust).

paths.description: Host filesystem scopes the plugin declares it needs. Declared + surfaced in the install UI; not OS-enforced in v1.

commands.description: Commands this plugin contributes. Each `run` template is spawned via `sh -c` with the plugin directory as CWD.

id.description: Command id, unique within the plugin.

run.description: Shell command template executed via `sh -c`. UI params are exported as `LITEDUCK_PARAM_<UPPERCASE_KEY>` env vars — never string-interpolated into this template (shell-injection guard).

args.description: Declared parameter keys this command accepts (documentation + UI hints).

view.description: Declarative-view hint for how the command's stdout is rendered by a trusted built-in renderer (no plugin JS/HTML). Absent or unknown → `text` (raw output). See the per-view output contracts in the liteduck `notes/2026-05-28_plugin-declarative-views.md` design note.

default.description: When true, LiteDuck auto-runs this command as the plugin's landing view when its page is opened. At most one command per plugin should set this.
